observations: Only observed permitted-fixture answers count. Missing answers, unobserved generations and prohibited scraping remain unsupported. Mentions, citations, source-version matching and factual correctness are separately reported.
history: Evaluation IDs are immutable and never replace earlier baselines. Comparisons retain prompt and catalog/model/configuration labels.
guarantees: No future placement guarantee, causal lift claim, prohibited scraping or real-model qualification.
privacy: Evaluation inputs use bounded fixture questions, product claims and source references. Each evaluation is resource/customer scoped, exported and minimized with that subject. Separate source transcript stores and held caller copies require cleanup.
